name: Cascade Watcher — bus-tail comms-cascade trigger
description: Tails apex-events.jsonl and routes failure-class / notable bus events through @openclaw/skill-reach-cascade. Editable trigger table; anti-recursion guards; anti-flood (3 fires per 5min per type+source); auto-promote-to-docket for medium/high introspect observations. Salvages chuck-cascade-watcher.mjs.

pollIntervalMs.label: Poll interval (ms)
pollIntervalMs.help: How often to stat the events file. fs.watch is unreliable for append-only logs on macOS APFS; polling at 500ms costs ~2 syscalls/sec.

antifloodWindowMs.label: Anti-flood window (ms)
antifloodWindowMs.help: Per (triggerType + source), more than antifloodMaxFires inside this window suppresses further fires until reset.

antifloodMaxFires.label: Anti-flood max fires
antifloodMaxFires.help: Max fires per (triggerType + source) inside the anti-flood window.
